# v2026.10.19

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.19.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/field/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.19.md).

This release covers **7 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Every theme is readable to WCAG AA, and CI checks the contrast. ([#169](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/169))
- Sign-in inputs and the Google button have a clear edge. ([#159](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/159))
- A republish no longer fails while the live copy holds the storage lock. ([#170](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/170))
- The invoice amount report reads emailed invoices in one query, not one for each job. ([#172](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/172))
- Sentry events carry product and client tags, and a cancelled fetch is not reported. ([#171](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/171))

## Changes

- Sentry events carry product and client tags, and a cancelled fetch is not reported. ([#171](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/171))

## Fixes

- Sign-in inputs and Google button show a clear edge. ([#159](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/159))
- Make every theme readable (WCAG AA), with a contrast audit in CI. ([#169](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/169))
- A republish no longer fails while the live copy holds the storage lock. ([#170](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/170))
- The invoice amount report reads emailed invoices in one query, not one per job. ([#172](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/172))
